## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `d8c784438122a611a508bf2f3980e22086c4883f`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md + .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/ui.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/cross-repo-coordination.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/release-aftercare.md, .claude/agents/os-dev.md, scripts/check-single-claim-paths.mjs (cited code, read not reviewed)

Inputs: card #28638 body and its three comments (triage 6561056425, claim 6561986711, dev report 6562327422); PR #28773 body, file list and the net diff against `main` at merge base 72533449d3 (3 files, +6/−6); the 45 check-runs on the head, read at 2026-11-01T18:59Z, none pending. Independent of the dispatch order and of the seat's own conclusions.

### ① Derived judgments

- No accept set and no public surface moves: the diff is rule prose under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` (frontmatter `metadata.internal: true`, not in the published `skills/` catalog). Right.
- Face: a governed path (`.claude/**`, Tier S by the register) ⇒ rules face, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`; lane `domain:skills`. Right.
- Line ratchet paid in content: `SKILL.md` 319/319, `seat-lifecycle.md` 96/96, `execution-duties.md` 188/188 on the head, same as on `main`; the six new or rewritten lines measure 120, 118, 120, 118, 120, 120 bytes (cap 120, inclusive); five content lines deleted, no re-wrap. Right. Each deleted rule has a live home on the head: 「同 session 的 subagent dev 认领不触发自退」 ⇒ `seat-lifecycle.md` L8 (reading three is the newest `Claim:` *not* from this session) + `execution-duties.md` L70 (`mode:subagent` 下 dev 与 PM 同 ID,身份看分支) + `cross-repo-coordination.md` L14; 「顺带发现只经立卡门」 ⇒ `SKILL.md` L283–285 (报告契约) + `filing-gate.md` L8–9 (four classes, ⛔ 其余一律不立卡) + `seat-lifecycle.md` L43–46; 「权威的墙信号是失败本身」 ⇒ `platform-readings.md` L443 (撞墙报文 `limit reached, resets at HH:MM`,重置时刻只此刻可得) + L50; 「每轮每次唤醒首读 `priority:p0`」 ⇒ `SKILL.md` L119 (`priority:p0` 插队:同轮立即派发) + `execution-duties.md` L51 (开放 P0/P1 每次取卡现读) + L54; 「该假设以机制假设身份进派发令,被证伪就在同一张卡公开更正」 ⇒ `execution-duties.md` L124–125 (三分区) + `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` L183 (证伪照实报告并按裁决意图换路) + `release-aftercare.md` L45–50 and `platform-readings.md` L306 (更正公开落到卡上). No script, gate or doc elsewhere in the tree anchors on any of the five deleted strings (repo-wide grep on the head: zero hits). Right.
- Gate verdicts on the head: every required context is `success` — Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core, Test UI, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Check PR Size; Build Core, Lint UI, Type Check UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI and the Dogfood matrix are `skipped` by the path selector (expected skips for a prose-only diff). Nothing pending. Right.
- `main` has not moved on `.claude/**`, `scripts/pm/**` or `AGENTS.md` since the merge base; the PR is mergeable. Right.
- No issue number cited in the skill text; no model identifier in the PR title or body. Right.

### ② Semver level

Nothing publishes from any released package: `skip-changeset` is on the PR and Check Changeset is green. `Clause-②: no` on the PR body is right — no accepted set widens and no public surface grows; `Metadata-protocol: none` is right, so no `Skills-docs:` line is owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev deviations (6562327422):
1. Merged `origin/main` before opening the PR — accepted; the net diff against the merge base is still exactly 3 files, +6/−6, and the merge touches none of the reviewed paths.
2. PR-body footer is the harness's Generated-with line, not the session-URL `Generated by` form AGENTS.md names for PR bodies — accepted as a declared prose deviation outside `hits`: the session id is durable in the Verification prose, PR-body guards are green, and the seat's 终稿 pass may correct the footer; no landing effect.
3. Sweep-1 exit 3 on `check:doc-formula-expressions` was a missing prerequisite — accepted; the head's Lint & Repo Gates conclusion is the verdict and it is green.
4. Card and comments read through `gh api` REST, read-only — accepted; reads are not writes and `api_writes` names only relay-channel writes.

`open_questions`: none declared, none found.

Out-of-scope findings:
1. `execution-duties.md` 认领 L64–65 (部分落地 ⇒ 余项整树归他席 ⇒ 点名该席改标) — the dev says both routes stand. Not quite: for a remainder wholly under `ui/**` that line names the `domain:ui` seat as the owner at release time while the new L45 dispatches the same card from this lane at the next refill. Both routes end with the card dispatched, and 席改标 is limited to undispatched cards (L10), so no destructive race — but the two lines name different lanes for one card, and the file is inside this card's surface. Answered as ④ should-fix 1, not escalated: the maintainer's words (「剩下部分是 UI 的卡照常派」) already choose dispatch, so no decision is owed.
2. The `domain:ui` lane row and `lanes/ui.md` L9 (跨层功能的 `ui/` 子单归本席) speak of triage-split sub-cards, not an unsplit remainder — agreed; 域车道 L154 (a `domain:*` label decides file ownership only, never a queue unit) and L176 (越界四通道) carry the reconciliation; no edit needed.

Seat-side note, not a PR finding: the claim comment's `Container & model:` line spells a model identifier where the template asks for a tier word (⛔ 不抄模型 id); the tree is clean of it. For the seat's own record hygiene.

### ④ Design judgment

**`SKILL.md`** — L74 now reads 「队列空(逐卡表见 `references/seat-lifecycle.md`)+ 无在飞 + 无待复核 + 决策箱无新答复 ⇒ 自退」, net-zero at 120 bytes. Against the eval scenario the pointer does its one job: the self-exit condition can no longer be satisfied by a bare "empty" reading, because the word now resolves to the per-card table. The lane table's `domain:ui` row is untouched and still correct — it names file ownership, and 域车道 bullet 2 says that is all a `domain:*` label decides. Holds. (Pre-existing, not this PR's: L74's 自退 sits beside `seat-lifecycle.md` L86's 待命非退场; the PR neither widens nor narrows that.)

**`references/seat-lifecycle.md`** — L87–89 against the card's "What happened" (a `domain:server` seat, seven graded unassigned `pm:queue` cards whose remainder is UI): each of the seven has no blocker in the vocabulary — unassigned, no `needs-user-decision`, no `pm:retriage`, a triage audit comment present, no open `Blocked-by:`, no sibling `Claim:` — so under L88 each is a candidate and the report may not say "empty"; the seat must list seven rows with labels and assignee read in the same turn. A seat reading this text on the head cannot reproduce the incident. The vocabulary is deliberately closed to the inverse of the candidate definition plus three blockers, and hold reasons that are not blockers (hot-file serial, `LOCK_DEPTH_HOLD`, the Tier H soft cap, same-axis in-flight, alternate pick) fall under 「无卡点即候选」 — the right outcome, since a held candidate is still not an empty queue. Holds. The three deleted lines in this file have the live homes listed under ①.

**`references/execution-duties.md`** — L45–46 against the same scenario: a seat reading 候选与批次 meets L8 (candidate definition), then L43 (self-split for another lane's item) immediately bounded by L46 (`ui/**` 余项不是他车道项,本席自派不拆;自拆只对整落 `ui/**` 外他车道树的卡自列独立项) and L45 (照常派 … ⛔ 不作 UI 跳过). "Skip" and "dispatch" no longer sit side by side: L43's scope is now stated to exclude `ui/**`, and `cross-repo-coordination.md` L11 (objectui 并入本仓 `ui/`) and L25 (a new spec key ships with its first `ui/` reader) agree with "same repo, same worktree, gates and merge queue". The lane row and `lanes/ui.md` L7/L9 remain true as ownership statements. Two findings, neither a must-fix:

- should-fix 1 — `execution-duties.md` L65 (认领, 部分落地): for a remainder wholly under `ui/**` it still routes the card to the `domain:ui` seat (点名该席改标) while L45 dispatches it from this lane at the next refill; the same file names two lanes for one card, and `SKILL.md` L45 (两条细则冲突 ⇒ 按更严的一条行动并立卡) would then cost the releasing seat a card. Fix: exclude `ui/**` from L65's 归他席 clause, within the 120-byte cap (the straightforward insertion lands at 133 bytes, so re-cut the line or pay with one more deletion). Not a FAIL: both routes end with the card dispatched and 席改标 is limited to undispatched cards, so the card is never left undispatched and unsplit.
- should-fix 2 — the pre-dispatch in-flight check: 域车道 L173 confines it to the lane's own `pm:dispatched` claims and L175 widens it to every touched domain only on the 跨域例外路径. L45 opens a second way for a non-ui seat to dispatch into `ui/**` and does not carry that widening, so a `domain:ui` in-flight card on the same `ui/**` files is invisible to the dispatching seat. Bounded by `SINGLE_CLAIM_PATHS` (one entry, `.objectui-sha`, enforced whole-PR by the single-writer guard) and by L22 (sharing other paths is ordinary concurrency, the later lander resolves), so a conflict costs a merge-queue lap, not correctness. Fix: one clause on L45 or L46 — the in-flight intersection for a `ui/**` remainder also reads the `domain:ui` lane's claimed surfaces — or a pointer to L175.

No must-fix. The tree, not the PR body, was judged: every line count, byte width and surviving home above was measured on `d8c7844381`.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `30106ea6b337a0d2826f99ee7858818806fa6314`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md + .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/ui.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/cross-repo-coordination.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/state-machine.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md, .claude/agents/os-dev.md (cited code, read not reviewed)

Inputs: card #28638 with every comment through the delta report 6562573892; PR #28773 body and file list; the delta diff `d8c7844381..30106ea6b3` and the full net diff against `main` at the unchanged merge base 72533449d3 (3 files, +8/−8); the 40 check-runs on `30106ea6b3`, read at 2026-11-01T19:13Z — all completed (22 success, 18 skipped by the path selector), none pending. Everything the first record judged and does not name here stands as judged there; the first head's findings are re-judged below.

### ① Derived judgments

- The delta touches one file, `references/execution-duties.md`: one line added (候选与批次 L47, 120 bytes), one line re-cut in place (认领 L65, 119 → 118 bytes), one content line deleted (the sub-issue / main-red direct-dispatch line). `SKILL.md` and `seat-lifecycle.md` are byte-identical to the first head. Line counts on the new head 319 / 96 / 188, all at ceiling; no re-wrap. Right.
- The deleted line 「该 sub-issue 与 main-red 锚卡各带域与级直接派发,绕过分诊;sweep 事后扫,重复关 `duplicate`」 keeps a live home for each of its three clauses: direct dispatch with inherited domain and grade ⇒ `SKILL.md` 域车道 L171 (两例外:sub-issue 承父卡域、main-red 锚卡,免审计评论) + `execution-duties.md` L11 (candidates without a triage audit: sub-issue 承父卡首触, main-red 锚卡) + L41 (认领席自有、优先级继承) + `triage-duties.md` L29 (main-red 锚卡由席位先立先派,首触事后补作记录级); the after-the-fact sweep ⇒ `triage-duties.md` L16 and L23 (standing per-fire backlog sweep); duplicates ⇒ `triage-duties.md` L70 (后卡关 `duplicate_of`) + `SKILL.md` L134 (重复 ⇒ `duplicate` + `duplicate_of`). Repo-wide grep for the deleted string on the new head: zero hits. Right.
- Dropping 同笔 from the Release line loses nothing: the same-stroke rule for a release is stated as a rule in `state-machine.md` L41 (行首 `Release:` 与清 assignee 同笔), `seat-post-protocol.md` L47 (同笔 `Release:`+`Resume-from:`+清 assignee 交回 `pm:queue`) and `triage-duties.md` L80, and the 释放 line directly above (L64, 合入同笔回 `pm:queue` + 清 assignee) binds the act; 已落项与余项 → 已落与余项 is the same reading. Right.
- Still no accept set and no public surface; still `.claude/**` Tier S on the rules face; `main` has not moved on `.claude/**`, `scripts/pm/**` or `AGENTS.md` since the merge base; the PR is mergeable. Gate verdicts on the new head: every required context success (Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core, Test UI, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Check PR Size); UI and Build jobs skipped by the path selector, expected for a prose-only diff. Right.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged: `skip-changeset` on the PR, Check Changeset green on the new head, nothing publishes; `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` stay right.

### ③ Boundary flags

Delta report 6562573892:
- Deviation (同笔 and one 项 dropped from the Release line to fit the cap): accepted — see ① for the live homes of the same-stroke rule.
- `open_questions`: none; `out_of_scope_findings`: none; `mcp_calls` 0; `api_writes` git push + the stamped comment only.
- PR body not re-sent this round, so its 维护者速读 and What-changes prose still say +6/−6 and tabulate five deletions where the tree now has +8/−8 and six; the dev names this for the seat's 终稿 pass. Prose outside `hits`, no landing effect; the seat corrects the six lines when it posts its record.

First-record items carried: dev deviations 1–4 and out-of-scope findings 1–2 of 6562327422 stand as answered on 6562438680; the seat-side note on the claim comment's `Container & model:` line still applies to the card, not the tree.

### ④ Design judgment

**`SKILL.md`** and **`references/seat-lifecycle.md`** — unchanged since `d8c7844381`; the judgment there (L74 pointer; L87–89 per-card table against the card's seven-card scenario) holds on this head.

**`references/execution-duties.md`** — both should-fixes of the first record are resolved on the tree:

- should-fix 1 resolved: L65 now reads 「`Release:` 行点名已落与余项;余项整落 `ui/**` 外他席树 ⇒ 点名其改标,拆分加 `pm:retriage`」. A remainder wholly under `ui/**` is no longer routed to the `domain:ui` seat at release; it returns to `pm:queue` on this lane and L45 dispatches it at the next refill. One lane per card; 认领 and 候选与批次 agree; the card's ⛔ (never left undispatched and unsplit) holds on both the refill and the release path.
- should-fix 2 resolved: new L47 「派 `ui/**` 余项前,在飞求交加读 `domain:ui` 的 `pm:dispatched` 认领文件面;相交 ⇒ 串行或让行」 carries the same widening 域车道 L175 gives the 跨域例外路径, bound to the one new route that needed it. The reading it asks for is the one L173 already describes (claim comments' declared file surfaces, local intersection), so no new query shape is introduced. Holds.

Against the eval scenario once more: a `domain:server` seat reading 候选与批次 on this head meets L8, L43 bounded by L46, L45 (照常派, ⛔ 不作 UI 跳过) and L47 (read `domain:ui` in-flight surfaces first); reporting "empty" over seven graded unassigned cards is excluded by `seat-lifecycle.md` L87–89. Tried and not broken: a ui-lane card with a server remainder still self-splits under L43 (the asymmetry is the maintainer's choice); `packages/console` is `domain:ui` by the lane row but outside `ui/**`, so a remainder only there is still 他车道项 — consistent with L46 and not reachable from the card's scenario.

No must-fix, no should-fix. Judged on the tree at `30106ea6b3`: every byte width, line count, surviving home and gate conclusion above was measured there, not read from the PR body.

## 维护者速读(席位终稿 · head `30106ea6b337a0d2826f99ee7858818806fa6314`)

- **改了什么**:席位报「无卡可派」时,必须逐张列出队列卡:卡号、当轮实时读的标签和 assignee、具体卡点。没有写明卡点的卡就是候选,报告不得写「空」。队列卡的剩余部分落在 `ui/**` 的,照常由本车道派发,不跳过、不当作他车道项拆走;派发前在飞检查加读 `domain:ui` 的认领。
- **为什么改**:你在 11-01 指出:server 席 3 报队列空,实际有 7 张已分级卡,只因剩余部分是 UI 就被跳过。按你的「立卡更新skills」,写成规则。
- **风险与回滚**:只改三份规则文字(`SKILL.md`、`seat-lifecycle.md`、`execution-duties.md`),+8/−8,行数不变,无代码。回滚 = revert。
- **先看**:`references/seat-lifecycle.md` 〈停止条件与待命〉新增三行;`references/execution-duties.md` 〈候选与批次〉新增三行。
- **两分钟验证**:拿 11-01 那 7 张卡套新规则:每张都没有词表里的卡点,所以都是候选,席位不能报「空」;`ui/**` 余项一行禁止跳过。
- **需要你做的**:批准本 PR(规则变更以你的批准为裁决)。契约复审 PASS:6562607614(`Head-sha: 30106ea6b337a0d2826f99ee7858818806fa6314`)。

**席位意见:ACCEPT.**

## 席位核对

- **形态:** 3 files, +8/−8 vs `main`. Line counts 319/96/188 unchanged; every edited line ≤ 120 bytes; no issue numbers in skill text. `skip-changeset`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- **执行档:** the dev ran at the tier `dispatch-gates --tier` mandates for `SKILL.md` (clause ①). The reviewer was a separate agent.
- **复审:** `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` PASS 6562438680 (first head `d8c7844381`, 0 must-fix, 2 should-fix) → patch round (delta report 6562573892) → delta PASS 6562607614 on `30106ea6b337a0d2826f99ee7858818806fa6314`, 0 must-fix, 0 should-fix. Every one of the six lines deleted to pay the ratchet keeps a live home (records ① cite file and line).
- **门禁:** dev's `dispatch-gates --commands` 20/20 exit 0 and `--ran` 0 NOT-MEASURED, both rounds. Check-runs on `30106ea6`: none pending, every required context success.
- **Item 3:** reconciled without a maintainer choice. The `domain:ui` lane row is about file ownership, and the maintainer's words (「剩下部分是 UI 的卡照常派」) pick dispatch over split-at-once. So nothing goes to the decision box.
- **PR 正文更正:** the body's change summary says +6/−6 and five deletions. The patch round made it +8/−8 and six deletions (adding the 部分落地 `ui/**` exclusion and the `domain:ui` in-flight read). This record is the correction, because the relay does not patch PR bodies.
- **接受的偏差:** PR footer is the 🤖 form with the session in body prose; no PR assignee — as on #28739.
- **范围外去向:** none open. The dev's two out-of-scope notes were answered by the review: one became should-fix 1 and is fixed; the other needs no edit. `Skills-docs: none — internal tooling`.
- **落地条款:** Tier S by the register. The PR stays draft with `needs-user-decision` until an authorised approver acts; then the seat clears the label, flips ready and enqueues.
